audit_scope: Post-hoc source-image duplicate screening for the fixed manuscript split

methods.screening: Equality of the released 64-bit perceptual hash
methods.confirmation: Visual inspection of every perceptual-hash group crossing the held-out test and non-test partitions

confirmed_pairs.classification: same cover stored with different image encoding
same cover stored as a resolution or compression variant

interpretation: The fixed split and reported manuscript results are retained for traceability. Two of the 194 test records have a visually duplicated source cover in the non-test pool under a different identifier. This is a benchmark limitation and should be disclosed; it does not justify describing the split as image-level duplicate-free.
